Definition: Uts, a son of Aram, also a Seirite, and the regions settled by them.
BiblicalUsage: Uz = "wooded"; n pr m; 1) son of Aram and grandson of Seth; 2) son of Nahor by Milcah; 3) an Edomite, son of Dishan and grandson of Seir; n pr loc; 4) the country of Job; probably east and southeast of Palestine somewhere in the Arabian desert
